## Change

Explain the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List meaningful checks, platform/tool versions, failures/skips and unverified optional behavior.

## Review

- Exact diff reviewed; no private projects/media, real approvals, secrets or machine paths.
- Dependency/asset provenance and applicable licenses/notices documented.
- Timing, treatment and encoded-artifact review gates preserved.
- Relevant docs, governing hashes, capability limits and Unreleased notes updated.

Exclude private scan reports/security vulnerabilities from public PRs; follow SECURITY.md for private reporting.
